info.description: Self-hosted IoT platform backend. Two binaries: api (HTTP/WS) and ingest (MQTT).
info.title: IoT Platform API

get.summary: Poll pending commands for a device

get.description:
Connect via WebSocket, then send JSON messages:\n
{"type":"subscribe","device_keys":["AABB..."]}\n
{"type":"unsubscribe","device_keys":["AABB..."]}\n
{"type":"ping"}\n
Server pushes enriched telemetry as JSON strings.

entity_type.description: EntityType names the kind of record matched, e.g. "device" or "audit".

id.description: ID is the entity identifier: device_key for devices, audit_log.id for audit.

label.description: Label is the human-readable primary text shown for the result.

subtitle.description: Subtitle is an optional secondary line (e.g. device type or resource type).
